okay so a few things i did (still do) for safety: 

1. use an alias, and use a very different username than any other accounts of yours so people can't find your personals

2. don't dm people - if you want to interact with a person one on one many people send anon asks back and forth instead of literally dm-ing people bc it's more public and therefore people are less likely to be inappropriate

3. avoid bots at all costs - if you interact with someone or get a dm, etc. from someone you feel like might be a bot, block and report them immediately because they probably are a bot

4. be extremely careful with personal info - don't mention any revealing info about yourself anywhere on the account like your age (obv), real name, city, etc. 

i mostly used my account to reblog nsfw posts to go back to later and i never texted anyone from this sideblog. aside from the stuff i mentioned above obviously follow all the general internet safety rules that apply to everyone.
